package zopfli

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"testing"
)

func checkRelaxation(t *testing.T, costs [maxMatch + 1]float64, lengths [maxMatch + 1]uint16, start, end int, base float64, terms *[maxMatch + 1]float64) {
	t.Helper()
	wantCosts, wantLengths := costs, lengths
	for i := start; i <= end; i++ {
		candidate := base + terms[i]
		if candidate < wantCosts[i] {
			wantCosts[i] = candidate
			wantLengths[i] = uint16(i)
		}
	}
	relaxStatLengths(costs[:end+1], lengths[:end+1], start, end, base, terms)
	for i := range costs {
		if math.Float64bits(costs[i]) != math.Float64bits(wantCosts[i]) || lengths[i] != wantLengths[i] {
			t.Fatalf("range [%d,%d], base %v, lane %d: cost bits %x want %x; length %d want %d", start, end, base, i, math.Float64bits(costs[i]), math.Float64bits(wantCosts[i]), lengths[i], wantLengths[i])
		}
	}
}

func TestRelaxationExperimentBoundaries(t *testing.T) {
	values := []float64{math.Float64frombits(0x7ff8000000000123), math.Inf(-1), -3, math.Copysign(0, -1), 0, 1, 4.25, 8, math.Inf(1)}
	for start := 0; start < 8; start++ {
		for count := 0; count <= maxMatch+1-start; count++ {
			var costs, terms [maxMatch + 1]float64
			var lengths [maxMatch + 1]uint16
			for i := range costs {
				costs[i] = values[(i+count)%len(values)]
				terms[i] = values[(i*5+count)%len(values)]
				lengths[i] = uint16(0xB000 + i)
			}
			for _, base := range []float64{0, math.Copysign(0, -1), 4.25, math.Inf(1), math.Inf(-1), math.NaN()} {
				checkRelaxation(t, costs, lengths, start, start+count-1, base, &terms)
			}
		}
	}
}

func TestRelaxationExperimentMasks(t *testing.T) {
	// Cover all eight-lane masks, alignments and overlapping tail positions.
	for start := 0; start < 8; start++ {
		for count := 1; count <= 24; count++ {
			for mask := 0; mask < 256; mask++ {
				var costs, terms [maxMatch + 1]float64
				var lengths [maxMatch + 1]uint16
				for i := range costs {
					if mask&(1<<uint(i%8)) != 0 {
						costs[i] = 2
					} else {
						costs[i] = 1 // Ties must preserve both cost bits and length.
					}
					lengths[i] = uint16(0xB000 + i)
				}
				checkRelaxation(t, costs, lengths, start, start+count-1, 1, &terms)
			}
		}
	}
}

var relaxationBenchmarkResult uint16

func BenchmarkRelaxStatLengths(b *testing.B) {
	for _, count := range []int{4, 8, 16, 64, 256} {
		for _, pattern := range []string{"none", "half", "all"} {
			b.Run(fmt.Sprintf("length-%d/%s", count, pattern), func(b *testing.B) {
				var seed, costs, terms [maxMatch + 1]float64
				var lengths [maxMatch + 1]uint16
				for i := range seed {
					terms[i] = float64(i%7) * 0.125
					seed[i] = 1 + terms[i]
					if pattern == "all" || pattern == "half" && i%2 == 0 {
						seed[i] += 1
					}
				}
				b.ReportAllocs()
				b.ResetTimer()
				for range b.N {
					// Reset every call so the hit pattern is stable after iteration one.
					// This common copy is included in all three builds' timings.
					copy(costs[3:3+count], seed[3:3+count])
					relaxStatLengths(costs[:], lengths[:], 3, 3+count-1, 1, &terms)
				}
				relaxationBenchmarkResult = lengths[3+count-1]
			})
		}
	}
}

func TestMeasurementDigests(t *testing.T) {
	profiles := []struct {
		name    string
		options Options
	}{{"default", DefaultOptions()}, {"fast", FastOptions()}}
	for _, profile := range profiles {
		for _, format := range []Format{FormatGzip, FormatZlib, FormatDeflate} {
			out := Compress(&profile.options, format, deterministicOptimizationFixture())
			fmt.Printf("fixture/%s/%d %d %x\n", profile.name, format, len(out), sha256.Sum256(out))
		}
	}
	for _, corpus := range benchmarkCorpora() {
		for _, profile := range profiles {
			out := Compress(&profile.options, FormatGzip, corpus.data)
			assertGzipRoundTrip(t, corpus.name, out, corpus.data)
			fmt.Printf("%s/%s %d %x\n", corpus.name, profile.name, len(out), sha256.Sum256(out))
		}
	}
}
